lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with roughly four to five discernible maxima per column within the field of view.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary linear features running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-to-shadow transitions from dorsal to ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex labyrinthine pattern of interconnected high-luminance serpentine ridges located immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, distinct from the standard punctate distribution on the rest of the flank.
